N4571A-27-R-0002 Page 13 of 106 Truth-seeking means the LLM is truthful in responding to user prompts seeking factual information or analysis. The LLM prioritizes historical accuracy, scientific inquiry, and objectivity, and acknowledges uncertainty where reliable information is incomplete or contradictory. Ideological Neutrality means the LLM is a neutral, nonpartisan tool that does not manipulate responses in favor of ideological dogmas. Significant Modifications means any changes made by the contractor or subcontractor to the AI model that could reasonably be expected to alter its adherence to the Unbiased AI Principles. For the purposes of compliance with the Unbiased AI Principles, this definition includes, but is not limited to, changes to training data and model architecture, and alterations to filtering and content moderation. (b) Contractor Obligation. The contractor must ensure that any LLM or other AI model provided under this contract complies with the Unbiased AI Principles throughout the period of performance. entity_geography.text: 2_Eigenerklaerung_Bezug_Russland-0422.docx ===== Entsprechend der Verordnung (EU) 2022/576 dürfen öffentlichen Aufträge und Konzessionen nach dem 9. April 2022 nicht an Personen oder Unternehmen vergeben werden, die einen Bezug zu Russland im Sinne der Vorschrift aufweisen. Dies umfasst sowohl unmittelbar als Bewerber, Bieter oder Auftragnehmer auftretende Personen oder Unternehmen als auch mittelbar, mit mehr als zehn Prozent, gemessen am Auftragswert, beteiligte Unterauftragnehmer, Lieferanten oder Eignungsverleiher. Ein Bezug zu Russland im Sinne der Vorschrift besteht durch die russische Staatsangehörigkeit des Bewerbers/Bieters oder die Niederlassung des Bewerbers/Bieters in Russland, durch die Beteiligung einer natürlichen Person oder eines Unternehmens, auf die eines der Kriterien nach Buchstabe a zutrifft, am Bewerber/Bieter über das Halten von Anteilen im Umfang von mehr als 50 Prozent, durch das Handeln der Bewerber/Bieter im Namen oder auf Anweisung von Personen oder Unternehmen, auf die die Kriterien der Buchstaben a und/oder b zutreffen. Bereits vor dem 9. April 2022 geschlossene Verträge mit solchen Personen oder Unternehmen mit Bezug zu Russland dürfen nur bis zum 10. Oktober 2022 fortgeführt werden. The current legacy analog infrastructure limits scalability, resilience, and interoperability. Under this Call for Solutions, the selected vendor will deliver, integrate, install, and acceptance-test a flexible, open-standard, modular Digital IF solution across up to twenty (20) worldwide satellite communications (SATCOM) teleport sites. Increment 1 will establish a fully operational baseline designed to support subsequent capability upgrades and integrations in future fiscal years. SECTION 2 – REQUIREMENT DESCRIPTION PROBLEM STATEMENT Area of Interest: Modular Digital Intermediate Frequency Solu

quires an open-standard Digital IF architecture. However, before committing to a full-scale global deployment, the DoW must validate the operation, interoperability, security, and performance of these modular commercial solutions in a rigorous representative environment. Technical Objective & Scope The DoW seeks a commercial solution for an Increment 1 Digital IF capability set built on a flexible, open standard (e.g., Digital Intermediate Frequency Interoperability compliant), modular architecture. The selected solution will undergo standard site acceptance testing and operational verification to confirm compliance with contract performance requirements and site compatibility. Upon successful acceptance, this operational configuration will serve as the standardized baseline for deployment and installation across up to twenty (20) worldwide SATCOM teleport sites. Mission Impact Successful validation and deployment of this flexible open-standard Digital IF architecture will directly enhance warfighter lethality and survivability by delivering a highly resilient, agile, and survivable GEO-SATCOM capability which rapidly adapts to contested/congested environments. deliverables_scope.text: ===== FILE: files/ACC-APG_Digital_IF_Call_for_Solutions_29October2026.docx ===== Capability Program Executive Command and Control Information Network (CPE C2IN) Commercial Solution Opening (CSO) Call for Solutions (CfS) for Product Manager Wideband Enterprise Satellite Systems (PdM WESS) Commercial Digital Intermediate Frequency Subsystem (DIFS) under the Army Open Solicitation (AOS) Commercial Solutions Opening (CSO) SECTION 1 - INTRODUCTION BACKGROUND Product Manager Wideband Enterprise Satellite Systems (PdM WESS) is seeking solutions for a Commercial-Off-The-Shelf (COTS) Digital Intermediate Frequency (IF) system to satisfy the requirements for Increment 1 of this modernization effort. The current legacy analog infrastructure limits scalability, resilience, and interoperability. Under this Call for Solutions, the selected vendor will deliver, integrate, install, and acceptance-test a flexible, open-standard, modular Digital IF solution across up to twenty (20) worldwide satellite communications (SATCOM) teleport sites. Increment 1 will establish a fully operational baseline designed to support subsequent capability upgrades and integrations in future fiscal years. SECTION 2 – REQUIREMENT DESCRIPTION PROBLEM STATEMENT Area of Interest: Modular Digital Intermediate Frequency Solu

quires an open-standard Digital IF architecture. However, before committing to a full-scale global deployment, the DoW must validate the operation, interoperability, security, and performance of these modular commercial solutions in a rigorous representative environment. Technical Objective & Scope The DoW seeks a commercial solution for an Increment 1 Digital IF capability set built on a flexible, open standard (e.g., Digital Intermediate Frequency Interoperability compliant), modular architecture. The selected solution will undergo standard site acceptance testing and operational verification to confirm compliance with contract performance requirements and site compatibility. Upon successful acceptance, this operational configuration will serve as the standardized baseline for deployment and installation across up to twenty (20) worldwide SATCOM teleport sites. To meet these ESR bunch injection schemes and requirements, an array of stripline-based kickers, individually fed by high voltage (HV) pulse signals of up to +/-30 kV, will be installed in the ESR. The required deflection angle is in the range 1- 1.5 mrad, for the individual stripline kicker we target a deflection angle of ~125 µrad @ 18 GeV, assuming +/-27 kV pulse supply voltage between the kicker electrodes. To keep the losses of the stored beam low, a ~15 σ distance between the stored beam and the injection septa in the ESR must be maintained, which translates into a minimum physical aperture of 30 mm diameter for the stripline kickers.
